pretreatments.description: Electrohydrolysis pretreatment using direct current (DC) applied between graphite electrodes (cathode and anode) immersed in a slurry of 200 g PPMS in 600 mL of distilled water. The pretreatment conditions were optimized by varying the applied voltage (V) and exposure time (minutes) at a constant 15 V, with a total duration of 45 minutes. The setup included a flash mixer rotating at 300 rpm to disperse the slurry. Current and voltage were monitored using an ammeter and multimeter.
